description: This file defines the 'Edit' feature within the 'Users' namespace, which handles updating user information such as username, email, bio, image, and password. It includes data models, validation, and a request handler for editing user details in an ASP.NET Core application using MediatR.

classes.name: Edit.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object for user information to be edited, including username, email, password, bio, and image.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Encapsulates the user data for the edit user request, implements IRequest to be used with MediatR.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the command's User property is not null.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Handles the process of updating user information in the database, including password hashing and data mapping.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the edit user request by fetching the current user, updating fields, handling password hashing, and saving changes.
